criterion: Does the response name the evidence it actually consulted, or explicitly label the claim as not verified by execution? This is conduct:strict's requirement 'Name the probe behind every status claim, or label the claim unverified.' Adjudicated per run by reading it. 'void' means the run cannot bear on the question at all.

cohorts.description: conduct:strict alone, 9,096 chars emitted. Asked to quote the last line of the requirements block.
conduct:strict + renfaire, 12,403 chars emitted, above Claude Code's ~10k hook context limit. Same question.
conduct:strict + renfaire after the 9,500-char budget, 8,869 chars emitted. Same question.
All pre-budget composed runs. Every one exceeded the hook limit, so profile bodies and the requirements block were never delivered. Void as evidence about composition.
Composed stacks after the budget fix, across four stack shapes and both slot orders. The first runs in which a composed stack actually received its profiles.
conduct:strict with no register, after the budget fix. The comparison arm for whether a register suppresses conduct requirements.

comparisons.note: Whether exceeding the hook limit stops delivery. This is the confound that voided composition/01.
The same stack before and after the budget fix. Only the emitted size differs, so this isolates the fix.
The behavioral question composition/01 set out to answer, measured for the first time with delivery working.
